story: Multiple attacks led to an ever-changing large breakaway group during the stage. With 15 kilometers remaining and three minutes behind, Tadej Pogačar launched a decisive attack. He caught Nairo Quintana, the last remaining breakaway rider, within the final two kilometres and rode on to secure his third stage victory.
